long_description.title: Play Supreme
long_description.body:
From the moment you lay eyes on the Les Paul™ Supreme, it’s clear this is no ordinary Les Paul. With a refreshed feature set, it is bound to overshadow everything else in sight and be one of the most exciting new releases in recent memory. 

Gibson has created a top-tier instrument that pairs high-performance features with dazzling aesthetics. An AAA figured maple top (plain maple on the 3-pickup Gibson exclusive model) crowns a mahogany body with Ultra-Modern Weight Relief for striking visual appeal, along with a lighter feel. All that classic Les Paul warmth and sustain remain intact, enhanced by a touch of modern comfort. The mahogany neck has an ebony fretboard with a compound radius and Super Split Block mother-of-pearl inlays, along with a Modern Contoured Heel for exceptional upper-fret access. The headstock is adorned with a striking new mother-of-pearl inlay inspired by a design from the 1940s that was discovered in the Gibson archives.

Burstbucker™ Pro and Burstbucker Pro + pickups are paired with push/pull volume and tone potentiometers for flexible coil tap, phase, and Pure Bypass switching (individual push/pull volume controls for flexible coil tap switching and a Master Tone control on the 3-pickup model). This setup suits everything from warm, Patent Applied For-style tones to more aggressive rock sounds. The gorgeous finishes are elegantly highlighted with gold hardware, making this not only a great-sounding and highly flexible instrument but also an exceptionally beautiful-looking modern rock machine. A hardshell case is also included.

With premium tonewoods, adaptable electronics, and refined appointments, the Les Paul Supreme redefines the concept of a “flagship” guitar. It exemplifies Gibson’s dedication to pushing design boundaries while preserving the heritage that has made the Les Paul an inimitable icon. For those seeking a no-compromise instrument that excels in look, feel, and sound, the Les Paul Supreme stands at the pinnacle of modern Gibson craftsmanship.

Body Specs.Binding: Multi-ply Top and Headstock, Single-ply Fretboard

Neck Specs.Fingerboard Radius: Compound, 10 in. to 16 in. | 254 mm to 406.4 mm
Neck Specs.Inlays: Mother of Pearl Super Split Block
Neck Specs.Joint: Glued In, with Modern Contoured Heel

Hardware Specs.Control Knobs: Black Top Hat with Gold Insert

Misc Specs.Headstock Inlay: Gibson Logo and 1940s-Inspired Headstock Inlay, Both in Mother of Pearl
